evisa.processing: About 3-5 working days (official guidance); apply at least 1 week before travel
evisa.eligibility: Citizens of all countries and territories (since 15 Aug 2023, Resolution 127/NQ-CP / Law 23/2023/QH15)
evisa.fake_site_warning: Only .gov.vn domains are official. Many look-alike sites (e.g. names containing 'vietnam-visa', 'evisa-vietnam', '.org/.com') charge USD 50-150+ for the same e-visa. The government fee is USD 25 (single) / USD 50 (multiple).
evisa.source: https://www.vietnam.travel/plan-your-trip/visa-requirements (Vietnam National Authority of Tourism); fees also confirmed by U.S. Embassy Vietnam

passport_validity: Passport valid at least 6 months beyond date of entry, with at least 2 blank pages (vietnam.travel). Visa-exemption entrants also need a passport valid >= 6 months.

visa_exempt.basis: Unilateral, Resolution 44/NQ-CP (7 Mar 2025), any purpose, any passport type
Unilateral, Resolution 229/NQ-CP (8 Aug 2025), tourism purpose, from 15 Aug 2025

Bilateral agreement (ordinary passports, in force 30 Jan 2025): 30 days per entry, max 90 days per year. NOTE: vietnam.travel lists Belarus under the 45-day group; KPMG reports Belarus was dropped from Resolution 44/NQ-CP. Conflicting - advise checking.
ASEAN / bilateral. NOTE: vietnam.travel shows 14 days; MOFA list and most secondary sources show 30. Unverified - conservative value 14 if in doubt.
ASEAN / bilateral. NOTE: vietnam.travel shows 30 days; MOFA list shows 14. Unverified.

notes: Visa rules checked 2026-11-12; no new unilateral exemptions in 2026 were found beyond Resolutions 44/NQ-CP (to 2028-03-14) and 229/NQ-CP (to 2028-08-14). The old 30-day gap rule between exempt entries no longer applies. Exemption stays cannot be extended into a visa without exit in most cases; stays longer than the exemption need the 90-day e-visa. Conflicts: Belarus (45 vs 30 days), Indonesia/Myanmar (14 vs 30) between vietnam.travel and other official/secondary lists - show 'check before travel'. US, Canada, Australia, India, China etc. are NOT exempt: e-visa needed. Affiliate terms change often; travel-network numbers are secondary unless marked; no program pages were signed into. All prices approximate. Transfer times are typical, excluding traffic/delays.
notes_public: Rules checked 2026-11-12. Visa-free stays cannot usually be extended; for longer trips use the 90-day e-visa. Phu Quoc island: 30 days visa-free for all nationalities arriving directly, without leaving the island. US, Canada, Australia, India, China and others need an e-visa.
